gloss: feeling of alienation, sense of exclusion

definitions.gloss: feeling of alienation, sense of exclusion
definitions.explanation: The emotional experience of feeling left out, disconnected from others, or not belonging to a group.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転校|てんこう}して→転校する：03444_tenkou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{疎外感|そがいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じている→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I've been feeling alienated since I transferred schools.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{疎外感|そがいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I sometimes feel a sense of exclusion at work.

examples.english: I felt left out because I couldn't join the conversation.

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{疎外|そがい}→疎外：13553_sogai⟧ (alienation) + {感|かん} (a productive suffix meaning "a feeling of ~", as in ⟦{孤独感|こどくかん}→孤独感：05995_kodokukan⟧ and ⟦{孤立感|こりつかん}→孤立感：21406_koritsukan⟧).

⟦{疎外|そがい}→疎外：13553_sogai⟧ ON ITS OWN: alienation as a concept (philosophical or sociological), or the act of shutting someone out. {疎外感|そがいかん} is always the subjective feeling on the receiving end.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {疎外感|そがいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ - to feel alienated (the everyday choice)
- {疎外感|そがいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ - to sense alienation (slightly more written)
- {疎外感|そがいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧ - to harbor such feelings over time
- {疎外感|そがいかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苛|さいな}まれる→苛む：28648_sainamu⟧ - to be tormented by it (strong, literary)

CONTEXTS: workplace exclusion, isolation at school, cultural and language barriers, social media, and counseling or mental-health discussion.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{孤独感|こどくかん}→孤独感：05995_kodokukan⟧ - loneliness; can be felt entirely alone, with no group involved
- ⟦{孤立感|こりつかん}→孤立感：21406_koritsukan⟧ - feeling cut off, with the emphasis on the objective situation
- ⟦{仲間外|なかまはず}れ→仲間外れ：06835_nakamahazure⟧ - being left out; the concrete act rather than the feeling
- ⟦{居場所|いばしょ}→居場所：12366_ibasho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - to have nowhere one belongs

The distinguishing feature of {疎外感|そがいかん} is that other people are present: it is the feeling of being among a group and still outside it.

REGISTER: Neutral to somewhat formal. At home in psychology and counseling, workplace discussion, social commentary, and personal reflection.
